senses.gloss: m. (χείριε, vocat. of χείριος = ὑποχείριος) in the control of, captive.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 53b:8">Erub. 53ᵇ</cite> (of a Galilean woman who wished to say <he>קירי</he>, κύριε, O Lord) <he>מרי כ׳</he>.—

<cite ref="Chullin 139b:14">Ḥull. 139ᵇ</cite> (of doves which uttered a sound like <he>קירי קירי</he>) <he>אמרה … קירי בירי</he> (corr. acc.) said she, blind one, say rather κύριε χείριε lord slave (an allusion to Herod the Great, v. <cite ref="E00830"><he>הַרְדְסִיאוֹת</he></cite>).—[<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 89:4">Gen. R. s. 89</cite> <he>כ׳ עבד קירי אדון</he>, v. <cite ref="K00625">preced. w.</cite>
